column1: Single deduplicated root-gap register across Personal / Group / Business / Shared Platform
• Audit coverage may be 100% while runtime readiness is below 100%. This register tracks deduplicated root causes, not every audit observation.
• P0 = launch/security/data-integrity/core-flow blocker. P1 = required V1 incomplete/incorrect. P2/P3 = non-blocking/deferred/cleanup.
• Close dependencies first. A domain row is not CLOSED until its stated exit evidence exists; code completion alone is insufficient.
• Shared Platform root gaps are dependencies for multiple domain gaps and should not be duplicated inside each domain.
